metadata.title: How To File a Claim - PA Treasury Unclaimed Property Tutorial
metadata.author: PA Treasury Department
metadata.shortDescription: This video was created by the Pennsylvania Treasury Department to help constituents file for unclaimed property. For more information about Pennsylvania’s unclaimed property program and Treasurer Stacy Garrity’s efforts to return more than $4.5 billion worth of unclaimed property, please visit https://www.patreasury.gov/unclaimed-property/

segments.text: hello everyone in this video I'll cover
the process of filing an online claim
via our website here's the main screen
for our site first go to patreasury.gov

menu then select start your search next

here the green gives you an idea of how

process the online process for finding

for our automated approval process that
means no paper claim form is required

amount of time it takes for you to
receive your money you can also speed up

also known as AC okay now let's get

name in the designated text box you must
type a minimum of two characters into

search you may also type your first name
or initial your ZIP code address or city
in each designated text box by
completing more of these optional Fields
your search becomes narrower so it's
probably a good idea to start by
entering only your last name and first
initial if you want to search as many of
our records as possible check the I'm
not a robot box then click the search
properties button at the bottom of the
page a list of results for potential
matches will appear if you identify
property that may belong to you review
the information and click the add box
beside each property listed that you
would like like to claim once you
finished adding properties click the
green claim properties in my cart button
at this point you'll see an option to
receive funds via a or direct deposit to
your bank account select yes or no let's
walk through these steps to be paid by a
after selecting yes you will be
presented with a claimant login screen
to register for an account select
register for an account on this form you
may be required to enter your personal
information that includes your first and
last name street address ZIP code city
state email phone birth date username
and password then click the save
registration button on the bottom at
this point you'll need to go to your
email to confirm your account after
clicking the link in the email you'll
get a confirmation message now you're
set to be able to sign in and register
for an ACH payment so click return to
claim and login log in using the
username and password that you just set
up then click the gold login button now
click the green claim properties in my
cart button next use the drop-down box
to select your relationship to the
property listed a popup box will appear
to further explain the relation ship
that you selected if all of the above
are true click yes you have the ability
to claim different properties at the
same time even if your relationship to
the properties is not all the same next
complete your claim and information form
fill in your first name last name street
address zip city state email phone
number and birth date all of the
information is required in order to move
on to the next step enter entering your
social security number is likely to
result in Faster processing if you do
not provide a social security number the
claim will not be eligible to go through
our automated approval process that
means you'll need to submit the PDF
claim form which will result in longer
processing time if you choose not to
provide your social security number
you'll be required to check the box
acknowledging that a social security
number was not provided if you're a
finder which means that you assisting
someone to recover their unclaimed
property for a fee Pennsylvania requires
you to become a registered finder refer
to the finder registration process on
our website at patreasury.gov unclaimed
property finders next for how did you
hear about this site select from the
drop- down menu finally check if you're
a veteran or active duty service member
for this demonstration a social security
number is required for AC age payment so
proceed with entry of your Social
Security number check the box to have
your property sent to you via acch
several blue boxes of important
information relating to the receipt of
funds by AC appear enter your bank
routing number and account number Select
from the drop- down box if the account
is a checking or savings and select how
you heard about this site you can accept
the terms and conditions of treasury's
affidavit and indemnification agreement
online immediately before signing the
claim form after this form is completed
click the create claim button answer
okay to the popup box if all of the
information is correct to create the
claim all submitted claims will be
showcased on the screen depending on the
type of claim and your relationship to
the property each claim form may have
different requirements listed if your
presented with the ability to generate a
PDF of your claim form then a paper
claim form is required you can fill it
out sign and upload the claim form
online you'll receive an email of the
claim form as a PDF along with a list of
two options to either upload a completed
claim form to our website or print and
mail the claim form to our PO Box
however if no PDF is presented that's
good news it likely means that no paper
claim form is required for the
claim to check the status of the claim
on our site you'll need the zip code and
claim ID for each claim which can be
found at the bottom of the claim forms
now I'll show you how to check the
status of a claim on our site it's very
easy the claim status upload forms tab
is displayed on the main screen right
underneath the already started need help
section to check the status of one or
any of your claims you simply fill in
the zip code and claim ID if you're
logged in the status of all your claims
is automatically presented on your
portal each status is labeled with a
specific color and each color references
a certain claim status for instance the
color orange is labeled as claim form
received by state you can also use this
page to upload claim forms if you have
any questions about the process please
email topmail patreasury.gov and our
unclaimed property staff will be happy
to assist you if you'd like to search
for unclaimed property in other states
visit missingmoney.com thank
